If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the export button logic to clear the busy state not only on success but also on failure of the exportReport call. This prevents the button from staying greyed out and disabled after an export failure, allowing the user to retry without reloading the page.
